name: incident-edge-contains-provenance-limit
body: Limit: this matrix's contains cells cannot discriminate plan-sourced Contains from scanner-sourced ones — both are the same (parent, child) FQN-pair set member with no edge properties or provenance, and the scanner re-emits Language→Module, Module→File, File→Struct and File→Function on the realization scan, so the cells prove the realized node keeps the edge, not that the plan-only row survived in isolation. The limit is structural (any plan edge that could differ from the scanner's is by definition an invalid pair finalize_graph should drop), unclosable by a test in the current graph model. Upgrade only if Contains ever gains edge properties or a provenance column.
